probe_items.goal: Verify a reusable OAuth or manual token session is available.
config_targets: onedrive session file or inline token
notes: Web PKCE, device code, and manual token are already supported.

probe_items.goal: Verify the configured root prefix and optional drive id can be resolved.
notes: Current provider health reports degraded until the root prefix exists.

probe_items.goal: Verify bucket-folder mapping under the configured root prefix.
Verify Graph minimal put/get/delete semantics under the mapped container path.
notes: This provider already supports object lifecycle roundtrip.

probe_items.goal: Verify Graph-backed rename/copy/move object actions under the mapped bucket-folder namespace.
notes: Current provider executes rename and move via driveItem PATCH with name/parentReference updates, and executes copy via Graph async copy monitoring.

probe_items.goal: Verify successful OneDrive object actions update replication metadata with the same semantics used by fallback gating.
notes: Current gateway semantics are rename=put(new)+delete(old), copy=put(dest), move=put(dest)+delete(src); OneDrive consumes these updates as an async backup or fallback target, not as a primary provider.
